result.summary: Found several visual issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest near you carousel, a profile control missing its icon, and inconsistent delivery-fee badge styling on the popular cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or truncate with an ellipsis so the full name remains readable.

issues.description: The top-right circular control shows only a red status dot on an empty light-gray circle, with no profile avatar or icon.
issues.suggestion: Add a user avatar image or a default person icon inside the circle so the control is recognizable.

issues.description: Delivery/promo badges on the Popular cards use different treatments (light pill for '€0 delivery' vs dark circular heart; '-20%' on a light pill) without a clear visual system, and the heart buttons sit on busy photo areas with uneven contrast.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge and favorite-button styles (consistent pill shape, background opacity, and icon contrast) across all restaurant cards.
